rule: An activity that no card grants is drawn for Admin only (the perms.isAdmin short-circuit in can.ts), so nobody else can reach it and no one-card login can test it. scripts/check-ungranted-activities.mjs fails on any activity+level listed nowhere here. Each record is a NAMED, DATED decision with its reason, never a count. A record whose activity is now granted fails the check until it is deleted. Admin itself is not a finding and is never given cards. foundNotRuled lists gaps the first run found that nobody has ruled on: printed every run as UNRULED, they do not fail the check, but a gap on neither list fails.

adminOnlyOnPurpose.reason: Moving an enclosure's plan is a rare, consequential act the shelter wants to stay with the administrator. Read is granted by cards; only edit is held by none.
Withdrawing a recorded death is rare and consequential; cards.ts keeps it off the residents card for exactly that reason.

Only Admin deletes a maintenance job ("Only admin can delete maintenance, keep it that way"). Recorded here 2026-11-09, not ruled anew; fault-maintenance-delete in scripts/lib/readonly-checks.mjs asserts the same thing on the live database. See also docs/card-access-faults.md.

Typing a corrected figure for one item outside a stocktake goes through record_stock_correction(), which requires this activity and the list's own edit; recording a physical count of a whole shelf is the separate stock.count. See the note on stock.diets and stock.medications: because he ruled those Admin-only too on 2026-11-12, the count box the two pages draw on list-edit cannot reach a card holder, so control and action do not disagree today.

Lutan, 2026-11-09, asked directly: "Yes they are Admin only." The status page shows the live health tiles and carries Check now, Run the alert check now and Send a test alert, the last of which mails every admin. Admin-only on purpose.

Ruled Admin-only in the one-at-a-time walkthrough, over the two alternatives put to him (a card of its own, or folding it into run_appeals). This settles the tension 0216 left open, which said the activity is "narrower than appeal.run: editing an appeal and publishing a wound photo are different powers" while his earlier remark had leaned towards the manage-appeal card. Nothing is silent: a login holding run_appeals still sees the medical photos with the tickbox drawn disabled and a message saying only someone allowed to show medical photos can choose them, which is the model the other silently-hidden controls should follow.

Ruled Admin-only in the walkthrough, over a card of its own or adding it to project_folders. Found and not fixed: a login holding project_folders opens a folder, sees the photos, and is drawn no Add button and no remove icon with no message explaining why. Hiding the controls is correct; saying nothing is a courtesy gap, and it is not this ruling's work.

Ruled Admin-only in the walkthrough. He had asked on 2026-11-09 whether this sat on the manage-website card; it does not, and told that, he chose Admin-only rather than moving it onto website_photos. This records how the Show on the website tickbox already behaves, so it needed no build. Consistent with his other two outward-facing answers the same day.

Ruled Admin-only in the walkthrough, over a card of its own ("Edit fixed outgoings") or adding it to view_cashflow. The argument he took was that the fixed monthly lines include salaries as one total, so the figures are sensitive even though the screen is internal; the cost he accepted is that the bookkeeping cannot be delegated without full Admin. Records today's behaviour: view_cashflow opens the forecast read-only and the Edit fixed outgoings link and the fix-it shortcut are not drawn.

Ruled Admin-only in the walkthrough, over one card covering both stock lists or a card each, with the cost named to him: this is routine work that comes up whenever a delivery arrives or a reorder point is wrong. Setting up the diets themselves is the separate diet_settings card and is unaffected. One consequence worth keeping: the page draws the stock count box for anyone with edit here, while the database demands the Admin-only stock.correct, so a card holder would have seen a box that always refused. Because this stayed Admin-only the mismatch is MOOT, not fixed, and it returns the day this edit goes onto a card.

Ruled Admin-only in the walkthrough, in the same answer as stock.diets. Covers the per-medicine stock settings, the Order view, the cupboard order, and uploading or removing a medicine's label. The same moot count-box mismatch recorded on stock.diets applies here.
